description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: Snow Shot is free, open-source screenshot software and a screen recording tool for Windows and macOS, with annotation, scrolling screenshots, offline OCR and image pinning. 免费开源截图软件，支持截图标注、滚动长截图、离线 OCR、贴图与录屏。
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.

Win顺：免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器。双击 Ctrl，拼音秒搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史（代替 Win+V）、对话框搜索、任务栏搜索、插件、AI 助手 MCP。Free Windows search launcher: pinyin file search, full-text search, clipboard history, MCP server. Everything/Listary alternative.
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
A fast file manager for Windows and macOS that never freezes: tabs, dual panes, archives as folders, Quick Look-style previews. A File Explorer and Finder alternative written in Rust.
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.
The Git-native time tracker for teams. Free forever, open-source, serverless. Your GitHub repo is your database. No subscriptions, no seat limits, no vendor lock-in.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.
Terminal-native AI coding assistant for real repositories. Inspect code, edit files, run tests, and verify changes from the CLI.
Beauty is productivity. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and 40+ more coding agents, side by side in one window.

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
Self-hosted life OS: habits, goals, Kanban, finance and focus, with an MCP server for AI.
Approve Claude Code from your Mac's notch. A native SwiftUI menu-bar app that surfaces Claude Code permission prompts, questions, cost and context usage, no tabbing back to the terminal.
